title: Israeli firm BlackCore suspected of meddling in New York and Scotland votes
summary: This Reuters investigative report reveals that Israeli firm BlackCore is suspected of interfering in elections in New York and Scotland, with concerns extending to potential interference in French elections in 2026. The article highlights growing concerns about foreign influence operations targeting democratic processes through digital manipulation tactics.
problem_solved: This article exposes suspected foreign election interference by an Israeli firm targeting democratic elections in multiple countries.
why_valuable: The report raises critical awareness about election security threats and the vulnerability of democratic processes to foreign digital interference operations.
